name: Pane
text: Pane: A one-click toggle to dark mode doesn’t fix the core failure—users in dark rooms still lose signals in shadows, and the toggle adds friction. The real risk is that critical errors vanish in either theme if contrast isn’t absolute. Settle it by testing a *single* high-contrast theme with *adaptive* brightness that auto-adjusts to ambient light, not a binary switch. Measure error rates and task speed—if users still struggle, the theme fails.
